title: [BUG] FVM not compatible with dart-sdk v3.13.0 (Chocolatey exact dart-sdk pin)
notes: Packaging defect, not FVM runtime. cli_pkg's pkg-chocolatey-deploy injects <dependency id="dart-sdk" version="[<build version>]"/> because the Chocolatey artifact is a Dart snapshot; the repo's own fvm.nuspec has its dependencies block commented out. NuGet treats the bracket as exact, so choco cannot upgrade dart-sdk past 3.9.0 while fvm is installed. Real fix is shipping the native Windows executable, which folds into the #1050 packaging workstream.
